summary.text: Jake Fitisemanu is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 30 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a community health program manager.

paragraphs.text: Jake Fitisemanu graduated from Taylorsville High School, earned a graduate degree from Westminster College in 2014, and attended Johns Hopkins University, according to Ballotpedia.
He has been affiliated with the Salt Lake County Board of Health and the Partners for Families & Children Coalition.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Fitisemanu said he has been elected twice to the West Valley City Council and is a long-time West Valley City resident.
He described his campaign messages as access and affordability, a focus on neighborhoods, and representation.
He listed public health and safety, education, employment and working conditions, housing and community development, and economic opportunity among his policy interests.
